finding: ServiceListVerifyScreen.jsx does not enforce the story-highlight confirmation as a mandatory guard before submission, violating FW-10 fixed 2026-08-04.
evidence: ServiceListVerifyScreen.jsx renders two informational cards ('Invite friends & clients' and 'Offer a free service to a Connector') with Learn more buttons that navigate away, but contains no submission form, no highlight confirmation checkbox, no armed-submit pattern, and no guard blocking submission until highlight is confirmed. The entire screen is informational only with no actual service-listing submission path.
fix: Add a submission form to ServiceListVerifyScreen that includes a mandatory checkbox ('I've added this service to my Story Highlight') that must be checked before the Submit button enables, matching the FW-10 spec that 'submit stays disabled until confirmed.' This screen should be the actual point where the user confirms highlight before their service listing publishes.
